limits: Automatic underlying portfolios currently support tested PPFAS schemes; unsupported or blocked AMC sources require scoped evidence imports.
No fabricated TRI, distribution adjustments, transaction completeness or switching tax. Published AMC endpoint returns remain separate from computed NAV/TRI history.
Normalized review priorities and health screens are application policies, not calibrated success probabilities.
Book references are bibliographic context, not proof that gated copyrighted text was obtained.
Synthetic screenshot positions and budgets are invented; public scheme/NAV/disclosure evidence is dated real source material.
Validation checks authored proof integrity and supported arithmetic; it does not independently authenticate user-uploaded source documents or guarantee financial outcomes.
